# Mind Map Page: review guide

Status: draft for review; not an installed skill.

## Outcome

An interactive map page with node editing, drawing previews, and configuration export.

Reader: People thinking with a structured map

## Procedure

### 1. Explore

Move from the workflow to sections and leaves.

### 2. Edit

Rename a node, add a child, or remove a leaf.

### 3. Draw

Open the drawing attached to a leaf.

### 4. Keep

Save in this browser or export the map configuration.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Rename and add-child operations appear immediately.
- [ ] Saved edits survive a reload in the same browser.
- [ ] Exported configuration can be imported back.
- [ ] Drawing links open real previews.

## Open design choice

Should editing a map create a new review round automatically?
